description: This file defines the MyInfoMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM Pim Menu namespace. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and configures a menu item labeled 'My Info' for a specific screen, using a menu service accessed via a trait.

classes.name: MyInfoMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the 'My Info' menu item for a given screen.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Returns the 'My Info' menu item if it exists, for a specific screen.
